inspected_small_metadata.e-H/README:
Integrated  cross section (a0^2) for e-H(nf,lf) <- e-H(ni,li) for ni <= 9 and nf <= 10 (note n=10 is denoted by the character ":").
TICS is the Total Ionisation Cross Section, which is the sum of cross sections for states nf with ef>0.
Note, in L-S coupling, due to degenerate energies, the transitions nf <- ni for nf = ni, but lf <> li, the cross sections are formally infinite, e.g. 2P <- 2S. 
Filename examples:
4F.2P is for nf=4, lf=3, ni=2, li=1
4F.2  is for nf=4, lf=3, ni=2, averaged over li=0 and 1
4.2   is for nf=4, summed over lf = 0,1,2,3, ni=2, averaged over li=0,1
inspected_small_metadata.README:
Integrated  cross section (a0^2) for e-H(nf,lf) <- e-H(ni,li) for ni <= 9 and nf <= 10 (note n=10 is denoted by the character ":").
TICS is the Total Ionisation Cross Section, which is the sum of cross sections for states nf with ef>0.
TCS is the Total Cross Section, which is the sum of cross sections for all open states nf.
Note, in L-S coupling, due to degenerate energies, the transitions nf <- ni for nf = ni, and lf = li +/- 1, the cross sections are formally infinite, e.g. 2P <- 2S. 
Filename examples:
4F.2P is for nf=4, lf=3, ni=2, li=1
4F.2  is for nf=4, lf=3, ni=2, averaged over li=0 and 1
4.2   is for nf=4, summed over lf = 0,1,2,3, ni=2, averaged over li=0,1

inspected_small_metadata.README:
Convergent Close-Coupling (CCC) calculations of e-He scattering using an up to 314 target states: l_max=5, N_l=25-l.

f.i files of integrated cross sections (cm^2) for e-He(nf,lf,sf) <- e-He(ni,li,si) for ni,nf <= 5.
TICS is the Total (one-electron) Ionisation Cross Section, which is the sum of cross sections for states nf with ef>0.
TCS is the Total Cross Section, which is the sum of cross sections for all open states nf.

Filename examples:
s4F.t2P are cross sections for nf=4, lf=3, si=0, ni=2, li=1, sf=1
TCS.s4D are TCS cross sections for ni=4, li=2, si=0

As at 13-Apr-2026 these resuts are unpublished, but are based on the CCC theory given by Fursa and Bray, PRA 52, 1279 (1995),
see https://journals.aps.org/pra/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevA.52.1279.

Available from https://atom.curtin.edu.au/ccc-db/index.html.
